title: VPN & Proxy Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy Protection
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk level when using VPNs and proxies. Get personalized recommendations to improve your online anonymity and security.
description: Evaluate your current VPN or proxy setup to identify potential privacy vulnerabilities. This calculator analyzes your configuration, usage patterns, and service quality to provide a comprehensive risk assessment.

inputs.label: Service Type
inputs.helpText: What type of privacy service are you currently using?

inputs.label: Provider Logging Policy
inputs.helpText: What is your provider's data logging policy?

inputs.label: Provider Jurisdiction
inputs.helpText: Where is your VPN/proxy provider legally based?

inputs.label: Encryption Standard
inputs.helpText: What encryption does your service use?

inputs.label: DNS Leak Protection
inputs.helpText: Does your service protect against DNS leaks?

inputs.label: Usage Frequency
inputs.helpText: How often do you use your VPN/proxy service?

inputs.label: Public WiFi Usage

options.label: Always use VPN on public WiFi

inputs.helpText: How do you handle public WiFi connections?

inputs.label: Sensitive Online Activities
inputs.helpText: Rate how sensitive your online activities are (1=basic browsing, 5=highly sensitive)

outputFields.label: Overall Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your privacy risk level from 0-100 (lower is better)

outputFields.label: Recommended Actions
outputFields.description: Steps to improve your privacy protection

formula: const serviceRisk = { 'paid-vpn': 10, 'free-vpn': 40, 'paid-proxy': 25, 'free-proxy': 50, 'none': 90 }[serviceType] || 90; const loggingRisk = { 'no-logs': 0, 'minimal-logs': 10, 'some-logs': 25, 'extensive-logs': 40, 'unknown': 30 }[loggingPolicy] || 30; const jurisdictionRisk = { 'privacy-friendly': 0, 'neutral': 10, 'five-eyes': 25, 'authoritarian': 40, 'unknown': 20 }[jurisdiction] || 20; const encryptionRisk = { 'aes-256': 0, 'aes-128': 5, 'basic': 20, 'none': 40, 'unknown': 25 }[encryptionLevel] || 25; const dnsRisk = { 'full': 0, 'partial': 10, 'none': 30, 'unknown': 20 }[dnsLeakProtection] || 20; const usageRisk = { 'always': 0, 'daily': 5, 'sometimes': 15, 'rarely': 25, 'never': 40 }[usageFrequency] || 40; const wifiRisk = { 'never': 0, 'protected': 5, 'sometimes': 20, 'often': 35, 'always': 50 }[publicWifiUsage] || 50; const sensitivityMultiplier = sensitiveActivities / 5; const baseScore = (serviceRisk + loggingRisk + jurisdictionRisk + encryptionRisk + dnsRisk + usageRisk + wifiRisk) / 7; const riskScore = Math.min(100, Math.round(baseScore * (0.5 + sensitivityMultiplier))); const riskLevel = riskScore <= 20 ? 'Low Risk' : riskScore <= 40 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore <= 60 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; const concerns = []; if (serviceType === 'none') concerns.push('No privacy protection'); if (serviceType.includes('free')) concerns.push('Free service limitations'); if (loggingPolicy !== 'no-logs') concerns.push('Data logging concerns'); if (jurisdictionRisk >= 25) concerns.push('Unfavorable jurisdiction'); if (encryptionLevel === 'none' || encryptionLevel === 'basic') concerns.push('Weak encryption'); if (dnsLeakProtection === 'none') concerns.push('DNS leak vulnerability'); if (publicWifiUsage === 'always' || publicWifiUsage === 'often') concerns.push('Unprotected public WiFi usage'); const primaryConcerns = concerns.length > 0 ? concerns.join(', ') : 'No major concerns identified'; const actions = []; if (serviceType === 'none') actions.push('Install a reputable VPN service'); if (serviceType.includes('free')) actions.push('Consider upgrading to a paid service'); if (loggingPolicy !== 'no-logs') actions.push('Switch to a verified no-logs provider'); if (dnsLeakProtection !== 'full') actions.push('Enable DNS leak protection'); if (publicWifiUsage !== 'protected') actions.push('Always use VPN on public WiFi'); if (usageFrequency !== 'always' && sensitiveActivities >= 4) actions.push('Use VPN more consistently'); actions.push('Use Incognito Browser for additional privacy protection'); const recommendedActions = actions.join('; '); return { riskScore, riskLevel, primaryConcerns, recommendedActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your privacy risk based on service type, provider policies, technical security features, usage patterns, and threat exposure. It considers factors like logging policies, jurisdiction, encryption standards, DNS protection, and your specific usage scenarios to provide a comprehensive risk assessment.
tips: Choose VPN providers with verified no-logs policies and independent audits
Avoid free VPN services for sensitive activities - they often log data or inject ads
Always use VPN protection when connecting to public WiFi networks
Test your VPN for DNS leaks regularly using online leak detection tools
Consider providers based in privacy-friendly jurisdictions outside surveillance alliances
Use Incognito Browser alongside your VPN for enhanced privacy protection
Enable kill switch features to prevent data exposure if VPN disconnects
Regularly update your VPN client software for security patches

interpretation.description: Immediate action required to protect your privacy
